description: Definitions relating the two main theorem statements to inputs, execution, resources, and communication rates.

items.explanation_zh: 2B≤M≤N 与 N≥2、B>0 均在公开声明；Mcut 的两分支穷尽。
items.explanation_en: the public statement contains all size premises; the two Mcut branches are exhaustive.

items.explanation_zh: 固定 c、κ 后，Covers 给出地址字数下界，hword 给出字长上界；常数先于规模固定。
items.explanation_en: fixed c and kappa bound word width on both sides; constants are fixed before varying size.

items.explanation_zh: 程序先由规模参数确定，再要求它对任意输入和临时存储内容都成立。执行长度可随运行过程变化。
items.explanation_en: The program is fixed by the size parameters and must then work for every input and every initial content of temporary storage. The execution length may vary with the run.

items.explanation_zh: 输入条件给出长度和 w 比特整数的磁盘存储格式。
items.explanation_en: Input conditions give the length and disk encoding of w-bit words.

items.explanation_zh: 同一最终磁盘写出同一个 output xs，同时具有 Perm 与 Pairwise；重复元素的次数得到保留。
items.explanation_en: the same final disk contains output xs, with both Perm and Pairwise, preserving multiplicities.

items.explanation_zh: run 累积每一步费用，正常分支给出有限 fuel 和停止状态；小分支的 Executes 是有限推导，输出与费用连接同一个 s→t。
items.explanation_en: run accumulates step costs; the normal case has finite fuel and a stopped state, and the small case uses a finite Executes derivation for the same initial/final states and cost.

items.explanation_zh: 普通内存情形计入缓冲区、目录、保存调用的记录和控制字。小内存情形使用两个 B 字缓冲区；窄字长执行位置采用模型页说明的约定。
items.explanation_en: Normal memory counts buffers, directories, saved-call frames, and control words. Small memory uses two B-word buffers; the narrow-word execution position follows the convention in Model.md.

items.explanation_zh: BoundedCode 限制实际读写的磁盘地址；即使地址由缓冲区内容计算，也要求所有可能的缓冲区内容都得到范围内的地址；磁盘块数乘 B 才换算成字数，指数只依赖固定字长常数。
items.explanation_en: BoundedCode covers actual accessed addresses, including arbitrary buffer contents; blocks are multiplied by B to count words, with exponent depending only on fixed word-width constants.

items.explanation_zh: 同一次执行的 result.2/cost 满足复杂度上界，coefficient 只依赖 c、κ。因为分母两个指数之和为 1，统一改变对数底数时，分子和分母的换底因子抵消。
items.explanation_en: The same execution cost, result.2/cost, satisfies the bound; coefficient depends only on c and kappa. Changing the logarithm base multiplies numerator and denominator by the same factor because the denominator exponents sum to one.

items.explanation_zh: 代码用有限类型具体定义网络的顶点和边；physicalEdgeEquiv 证明这些边与对应简单图的边一一对应。协议每边每轮一比特，路由每边容量为 1。
items.explanation_en: Finite types define the network vertices and edges explicitly; physicalEdgeEquiv gives a bijection with the edges of the corresponding simple graph. Coding permits one bit per edge per round and routing uses unit edge capacities.

items.explanation_zh: 正确性对非空会话集合中所有独立原始消息的任意取值成立，每个会话的源点与目的点不同。
items.explanation_en: Correctness holds for every assignment of independent original messages to the nonempty set of sessions. Each source differs from its destination.

items.explanation_zh: 初始化使用本地源消息；发送使用发送者状态，更新使用关联边上的消息。发送安排由时间和边确定。
items.explanation_en: Initialization uses local sources; transmissions use the sender state and updates use incident-edge messages. The schedule is determined by time and edge.

items.explanation_zh: 初始化、发送、更新、译码四项线性性属于同一个实际 BlockCode；correct 是对每个输入的零差错译码。
items.explanation_en: all four linearity conditions concern the same actual BlockCode; correctness is zero-error decoding for every input.

items.explanation_zh: 所有允许的通信协议的速率都不超过 1，因此二元线性编码也满足这一上界。对每个 r<1，代码都构造了速率大于 r 的二元线性编码，所以二元线性编码的容量恰好为 1。
items.explanation_en: Every permitted communication protocol has rate at most 1, so binary linear codes satisfy the same bound. For every r<1, the construction gives a binary linear code with rate greater than r. Their capacity is therefore exactly 1.

items.explanation_zh: 非负流量在两个方向上共用边容量。代码允许的游走包含源宿路径，因此其上界适用于分数路径路由。
items.explanation_en: Nonnegative flows share edge capacity across both directions. The walk formulation includes source-to-destination paths, so its upper bound applies to fractional path routing.

items.explanation_zh: 编码和路由使用同一网络、同一组源宿点对。总边长由所构造电路中各条连线两端矩阵差的秩求和得到。
items.explanation_en: Coding and routing use the same network and source–destination pairs. The total edge length is obtained by summing the ranks of endpoint-matrix differences across the constructed circuit.

items.explanation_zh: 有限二元线性编码的速率超过 1−33/338432；取整公式版本给出相应的有限块长。
items.explanation_en: The finite binary linear code has rate above 1−33/338432. The ceiling formula specifies a finite block length that achieves this rate.
